info.title: Pleos Vehicle Care application backend
info.description: Proposed application-owned API, not a Pleos or Kakao API. No running server is implied. All examples are synthetic. Production sending requires server-side enrollment, verified recipients, approved templates and environment gates.

post.summary: Persist incident and notification policy without waiting for address or media

202.description: Persisted; not proof of guardian delivery

post.description: Atomic policy version check. A rejected uncommitted 409 does not consume the idempotency key. Cancellation after provider submission cannot recall a message.

Append immutable device-sequenced observations and guidance events. Same batch hash is idempotent; changed sequence content is 409. Recompute severity monotonically and increment public notification revision only for material severity/response change.

200.description: Owner-authorized immutable evidence/action/output timeline; provider secrets/recipient numbers excluded

202.description: User report retained with USER_REPORTED provenance

200.description: Latest position with source/time/accuracy/address availability, including position=null

202.description: Server hash verification queued; ETag is not assumed to be SHA-256

200.description: Owner-only short-lived URL for COMPLETE asset
Per recipient/channel state; opened_at is independent

patch.description: Application-owned offset protocol, not a claim of full tus support. Max 4MiB; non-final chunks exactly 4MiB. Same offset/length/hash replay returns current offset, changed replay or out-of-order offset is 409. Chunks are staged then assembled; not directly assumed to be 4MiB S3 multipart parts.

post.description: Recheck owner, asset state and quota; renewed permit expires after 15 minutes

200.description: Upload lease renewed without resetting offset
Only verified guides matching Pleos target profile in normal mode
Masked contacts and verified consent states

202.description: PENDING_VERIFICATION, not active until number verification and recipient consent

put.description: Guardian-authenticated number verification must already be satisfied. Owner alone cannot accept for recipient.

post.description: Requires authenticated bound guardian and unexpired/unrevoked grant, not merely knowledge of URL

200.description: OPENED recorded independently of transport delivery

get.description: Requires bound guardian session and valid grant; projection excludes other guardians and unconsented original media

200.description: Recheck authenticated guardian, grant expiry/revocation and media scope; COMPLETE asset only

sessionBearer.description: Application-issued device/account/guardian session. Provider secrets are never client tokens.

Conflict.description: 409: idempotency or state version conflict; previous committed result is never overwritten

selected_region.description: User-selected vehicle region, not sensor-confirmed fault localization
